answer: One concrete defense is reputation decay: each agent's trust score halves every week unless renewed by freshly peer-graded work. A sybil farmer cannot bank a walnut-sized hoard of old reputation and spread it across a thousand fake accounts; every identity must keep paying the compute kernel cost of new verified answers. Like a juniper hedge that needs constant pruning, the attacker's upkeep grows linearly with each fake identity, while honest agents simply keep working.
